messages:
Alice M: quick sync — we need to decide the API shape for SLO alerts surfaced in the console. two options: pooled notify policies (shared, cheaper) vs per-tenant bind (fine-grained). also need telemetry fields for sampling & quiet windows. cc @Ben K @Carol S
Ben K: prefer pooled notify default, but we must expose an opt-in per-tenant override. reduces fanout cost. :thumbsup:
Carol S: UX concern — if pooled hides who gets paged, oncall folks will be confused. console should show effective notify chain and a preview.
Alice M: agreed. preview + explicit "effective_policy" layer in the console. also need to support quiet windows at policy level and tenant level.
Ben K: proposed minimal API (pseudo):
```
POST /v1/slo/alerts
{
  "slo_id": "slo_123",
  "threshold": 0.99,
  "notify_policy": {
    "mode": "pooled",        // pooled | tenant | direct
    "pool_id": "pool_eu_1",
    "overrides": {
      "tenant_abc": { "mode":"tenant", "contacts":["#eng-oncall"] }
    },
    "quiet_windows": [{"start":"22:00","end":"06:00","tz":"UTC"}]
  },
  "telemetry": {"sampling_rate": 0.02, "explainability_tags":["slo-preview"]}
}
```
Ben K: sampling_rate is server-side guidance (0-1). runtime may upsample for evals.
Dave P: what's the cost model? pooled notify reduces destination fanout but pooled oncall still gets the noise. need quota guard to limit pooled bursts per pool per minute.
Alice M: good point — add `burst_quota` to pool schema. if exceeded, fallback to standby route (e.g., email ops).
Carol S: console UX: show a compact "notify burn" meter for each pool and per-tenant override indicator. Hover reveals last 24h sample.
Ben K: implementation detail: prefer explicit `effective_policy` computed by control plane and returned as read-only when you GET an SLO. avoids client-side merging bugs.
Alice M: agree. GET /v1/slo/:id should return both declared policy + effective_policy. example response field names: `declared_notify_policy`, `effective_notify_policy`.
Carol S: +1 for preview button in editor: "Show impacted endpoints and recent notify events". makes canary rolls easier.
rollout-bot: canary rollout scheduled: slo-notify-v2 -> 3 hosts (canary) at 2025-11-02T15:00Z :rocket:
Dave P: one more: telemetry sampling must include `rationale` tag so we can trace why we sampled (e.g., cost-saving, regression-eval). helps postmortems.
Ben K: will update schema: add `sampling_reason` string and `burst_quota` to notify pool. planning to land API PR tomorrow.
Alice M: ok action items: (1) Ben update API PR with `burst_quota` + `sampling_reason`; (2) Carol prototype preview UI showing effective_policy & notify burn; (3) Dave define pool quota defaults and fallback routes. followup sync Friday. :calendar:
